dataset_note: roster = notional organizational roster workbook v2 (demonstration data, imported by scripts/import_roster.py); guide = Build Guide conformance fixtures (used by the test suite and the labeled evaluation). Override with STRATACASTER_DATASET.

clock.note: Fixed demo clock for reproducibility. Set to null to use system time.

llm.mode_note: auto = Claude when ANTHROPIC_API_KEY or ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN is set, otherwise the deterministic mock. Override with STRATACASTER_LLM_MODE=mock|claude.

feedback_check.mode_note: Employee feedback before MSR submission (PR-30). local = free: keyword hits plus local embedding similarity, no model call; the result is preliminary and the Role Execution Agent assesses at submission, including the recommended new task the TTO lead sees. hybrid = deployment option: the same free alignment plus one call to the small model below that writes recommended new tasks for unmatched statements only, so the employee sees them before submitting. model = deployment option: the full Role Execution Agent check (main model), reused at submission. Override with STRATACASTER_FEEDBACK_MODE.

hybrid_llm.price_note: Claude Haiku 5.5 list price for prompts of 100K tokens or fewer; confirm current pricing before deployment.

governance.note: Separation of duties. false: a person's management authority (Delivery operator, PMO reviewer) does not apply to their own MSR or to evidence derived from it; they act on it only as an employee. Set true to allow it.
